{{Quote|I win! I got three banthas in a row!''"''<br />''"''You lose, I'm banthas.''"''<br />''"''No, you're mynocks!|Two battle droids playing banthas and mynocks|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion]]''</ref>}}
'''Banthas and mynocks''' was a simple game that the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Ace (clone trooper)|18]] played while he was young. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a pair of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] played [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] and [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] whilst on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. However, a trio of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers approached and disabled the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], ending the droids' game.
